fields.title: 📖 Zayd ibn ʿAmr: No slaughter for idols
fields.body:
🖋️ **Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl** said to the Quraysh:

***“I do not eat of what you slaughter upon your sacrificial stones; I eat only of that over which the name of Allah was mentioned.”***

He rebuked the slaughters of the Quraysh because they were done upon other than the name of Allah.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Zayd showed a clear **Barāʾah** from Shirk in worship and in slaughter. This is a general rejection of a practice of Shirk, not automatically a named individual judgment upon every specific person.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb Manāqib al-Anṣār, Bāb Ḥadīth Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl, Ḥadīth Nr. 3826.
